The software products and platform services provided at **claris.com** (including Claris Studio, Claris Connect, and the Claris suite) are directly operated and provided by **Claris International Inc.**

### Provider Evidence:
* According to the **Claris Privacy Policy** at claris.com:  
  > *"Your privacy is important to Claris International Inc. and Claris International (UK) (“Claris,” “we,” or “our”)."*
* According to the official **Claris Terms of Service**:  
  > *"THIS LEGAL AGREEMENT... BETWEEN YOUR COMPANY OR ORGANIZATION... ON THE ONE HAND AND CLARIS INTERNATIONAL INC. AND /OR CLARIS INTERNATIONAL (COLLECTIVELY REFERRED TO AS “CLARIS”) ON THE OTHER HAND... Claris is the provider of the Service and compatible Claris offerings..."*
